resources.string: Dynamic resolution: lowers the 3D resolution when the GPU is busy; the same switch as Video → Dynamic Resolution in the game menu
Dynamic resolution: available once the game has started (or in the game menu: Video → Dynamic Resolution)
Dynamic resolution could not be changed here; use the game menu: Video → Dynamic Resolution
System (vendor driver; also the fallback if another driver fails)
In use now: system driver (%1$s did not start)
Vulkan driver %1$s did not start on this device (%2$s); the system driver is used.
The last launch with Vulkan driver %1$s crashed or froze, so the system driver is used now. You can select it again in Settings.
Vulkan driver %1$s failed to start on this device, so the game now uses the system driver. Custom drivers are experimental. You can pick it again in ⚙ → Vulkan driver.
Auto: a wider screen gets a wider view, a 4:3 screen a 4:3 picture. 4:3 on a wide screen adds side bars.
Upscale to screen resolution (GSR): sharper edges, a bit more GPU load
Move stick: game dead zone compensation
Aspect ratio: from the next launch
Faded: barely visible, works as before; set how visible with the slider below.
Dynamic resolution target, fps (it lowers the 3D resolution to keep this frame rate)
With dynamic resolution on, it picks the 3D resolution itself; this value is used when it is off.
Light mode: Switch handheld quality (no ambient occlusion and reflection probes, simpler shadows and filtering, 3D at most 80 % x 90 %) for weak devices
Light mode is not available with this game build: update main.patched.bin
Allow access to files so the game can read its files in Download/DOOM Mobile. Tap here, allow access, then return.
Game files were not found in Download/DOOM Mobile. On a PC, run setup with your own game files, then copy the \"DOOM Mobile\" folder it makes to the phone\'s Download folder.
The patched game modules are missing (Download/DOOM Mobile/dm/out). Run setup on the PC again and copy the whole \"DOOM Mobile\" folder to the phone\'s Download folder again.
The shaders are missing (Download/DOOM Mobile/dm/shaders). Run setup on the PC again and copy the whole \"DOOM Mobile\" folder to the phone\'s Download folder again.

Choose the \"DOOM Mobile\" folder (the one with romfs and dm inside) or the folder that holds it. Without a choice the game looks for Download/DOOM Mobile on the phone\'s storage, SD cards and USB drives.
An SD card or USB drive is slower than the phone\'s own storage: expect longer loading and possible stutter.
This is not a folder on the phone\'s storage, an SD card or a USB drive. Choose a folder there, or type its path.
This phone has no system folder picker: type the path instead.
Game folder saved: %1$s. It is used from the next launch.
The chosen game folder %1$s cannot be used (%2$s). Found automatically and used instead: %3$s
cannot be read (Android 10 may keep SD cards and USB drives closed to apps)
Aim Assist on (the game\'s own switch, as in its controller settings)
%1$s: available once the game has loaded its profile (or change it in the game menu)
Aim Assist, Motion aiming and its sensitivity are the game\'s own settings (controller settings in the game menu): a change here or there shows in both and is kept in the game profile.
A game setting could not be changed here; use the controller settings in the game menu

Off: the fast settings of version 0.5 always (experimental). Auto: they are turned off step by step after a crash in the graphics driver. On: always off (slower, but more compatible) – try it if you see flickering, wrong colours or other picture problems.
This run: step %1$d of 3 (graphics crashes counted: %2$d)
The last run ended with a crash in the graphics driver.
Step 1 of 3 is on now: the experimental speed-ups of version 0.5 for Mali / PowerVR (zero-copy memory and others) are turned off.
Step 2 of 3 is on now: the speed-ups of version 0.5 and the tile-GPU optimizations are turned off.
Step 3 of 3 is on now: the most compatible (and slowest) mode – the speed-ups, the tile-GPU optimizations and some shader shortcuts are turned off.
Safe mode is off (⚙ or dm/env), so nothing was changed.
If the game crashes again, the next step will be tried.
You can change this in ⚙ → Safe graphics mode.
If it keeps crashing, please send the files from %1$s with a bug report.
Zero-copy memory (an experimental speed-up) did not pass its test on this device and is off for this run.
The graphics driver reported a sync error; the game recovered and switched to a safer sync mode for this run.
The graphics driver failed to build a shader; some effects may be missing. Shaders are now built one at a time for this run.
Tap to restart in safe mode.
